prop.scope: Real Prop HTTP/domain/SQL fixture; explicit gated feed, synthetic pre-upstream 503, and stale expected_prop_revision injection. Recovery uses page reload followed by one new step.
checks: Committed replay chart publishes before gated Prop feed; subsequent step/trade writes remain locked until real feed settles
failure503: committed replay retained; reload has no POST; one new step feeds old backlog and new mark once in sequence
